'''Illares''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Galactic War]]. Around [[3641 BBY]] he was present at the [[Prison Administration Center]] during the [[Invasion of Belsavis]].
